description: This source file defines a generic copier class for handling deep copying operations of RepeatedField collections in Orleans serialization system, utilizing external proxies like Google.Protobuf.Collections.RepeatedField and Orleans.Serialization.Cloning.IDeepCopier.

classes.name: RepeatedFieldCopier<T>
classes.description: A sealed class implementing deep copying logic for RepeatedField<T> collections, facilitating duplication with potential property preservation and handling different input types.

methods.name: RepeatedFieldCopier(IDeepCopier<T>)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the copier with a specific deep copier for the element type T.

methods.name: DeepCopy(RepeatedField<T>, CopyContext)
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the input RepeatedField, utilizing caching via the context to avoid redundant copying.

methods.name: DeepCopy(RepeatedField<T>, RepeatedField<T>, CopyContext)
methods.description: Copies elements from input to output RepeatedField, respecting deep copy semantics for the element type T.
